story: Bitfinex fails to perform promised audits
text: Obligatory matching advice: [LINK] The full seminar is worth watching as well: “How do I secure my bitcoin?” — Andreas Antonopoulos [VIDEO]

Didn't have a multisig BTC wallet before (created one in the past, but deleted it months ago) and I don't seem to be able to add another multisig wallet - only those multi-email-confirmation-required wallets. Not holding the keys for my own coins is not an option (see [VIDEO] for why), but at least there are alternatives such as Ledger hardware wallets.
